subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — POC milestone runway & acceptance items
body:
From: Claire Thompson <claire@brightbridge.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightbridge.health>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & POC timeline - Week 1 checkpoint

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks — quick check in from our side after completing the first two integration days. High-level notes:
- Ingest pipeline connected to staging but we saw 2 schema mismatches on patient metadata (rows 14/102).
- Initial latency samples look ok (median ~180ms for 512-token prompts) but one DAG job timed out yesterday.
- Procurement wants the MAP milestone list and a simple acceptance checklist for their legal.

Can you confirm the acceptance criteria we discussed (perf thresholds + data coverage), and whether you can deliver the MAP workbook with ownership updated by EOD Monday? I attached our copy with comments.

Thanks,
Claire

[Attachment: BrightBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@brightbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:30:43 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & POC timeline - Week 1 checkpoint

Claire — appreciate the quick update. Below is a concise runbook we’ll track weekly; I’ve also uploaded the working MAP and the POC testplan to the shared Drive (link at bottom).

Milestones (next 3 weeks):
- Week 1 (this week): Data ingestion + schema validation (owner: BrightBridge: Claire; Redwood: Marissa) — acceptance: full ingest of 10K rows, zero critical schema errors.
- Week 2: Model integration & latency tuning (owner: Redwood: Karthik) — acceptance: p95 latency <= 500ms for 512 tokens, end-to-end pipeline < 2s for 128 tokens.
- Week 3: Eval run + acceptance gates (owner: Rishi) — acceptance: MAP eval metrics meet thresholds (see below).

Open blockers we see:
1) Data access: staging credentials expire Jan 10; need extension (BrightBridge action).
2) DAG job timeout: likely task parallelism; engineering will increase worker concurrency as a short term fix.
3) SOC2 evidence for procurement — Rishi, can you surface where we store the relevant reports?

Action items (short):
- Claire: extend staging creds to 2027-01-18 (Due: 2027-01-10).
- Marissa: resolve schema mapping for patient_metadata by applying transformation v2 in ETL (Due: 2027-01-11).
- Karthik: push latency cap config and run week-2 smoke tests (Due: 2027-01-14).
- Rishi: prepare SOC2 summary and a 1-page evaluation checklist (Due: 2027-01-12).

Acceptance criteria (evaluation plan excerpt):
- Data coverage: >= 95% of expected fields populated across sample set (n>=5K).
- Robustness: < 1% drop rate across retries under 95th percentile load.
- Quality: end-to-end precision on labeled test set >= 88% (detailed eval artifacts in Drive).

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDE-example-MAP

Attachments: POC_testplan.md (summary of test harness and eval commands).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Claire Thompson <claire@brightbridge.health>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 10:12:08 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & POC timeline - POC evaluation metrics and gating

Adding a couple of specifics on the eval plan and measurement windows so procurement has something concrete: 

Evaluation plan (detailed):
- Dataset: use BrightBridge labeled dev set (n = 10,000) with stratified sampling across facility types. We'll run three independent eval passes during Week 3.
- Metrics: precision/recall/F1, latency p50/p95/p99, per-field coverage, and stability under 2x concurrent load.
- Pass thresholds (proposal): F1 >= 0.88, p95 latency <= 600ms, coverage >= 0.95. If two of three passes meet thresholds, we consider the gate passed; otherwise we escalate to a joint triage.

Required infra items:
- We need access to request-level logs for the staging cluster for Jan 9–15 window (owner: BrightBridge infra).
- Please confirm whether any PHI-scrubbing steps are required before we ingest the dev set into our test harness.

SOC2 evidence: we can share a redacted SOC2 summary now and full report through the secure link once procurement signs the NDA.

Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Applied ML — Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightbridge.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:05:19 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & POC timeline - Week 1 checkpoint

Thanks everyone — helpful. We’ll do the credential extension today (Claire will confirm), and procurement is asking for the acceptance checklist in a single doc (simple pass/fail rows). I’ll have our procurement rep loop in next email if needed.

Claire: can you upload the sample dev set to the secure S3 share by EOD Monday? If there are PHI concerns we’ll redact and note which fields are removed.

Tom
Head of Data Engineering
BrightBridge Health

Quick closure — thanks all for the alignment. Confirming the follow-ups we’ll own and the joint items: 

Open actions (final recap):
- Claire (BrightBridge): extend staging creds to 2027-01-18 (Due: 2027-01-10).
- Marissa (Redwood): apply ETL transform v2 and re-run schema validation (Due: 2027-01-11).

- Rishi (Redwood): SOC2 summary + 1-page acceptance checklist (Due: 2027-01-12).
- Tom (BrightBridge): upload dev set to secure S3 or confirm redaction plan (Due: 2027-01-11).

Next sync: same time next Friday for a quick 30-minute gate review. If any blocker moves to critical, please flag in the MAP doc and ping the #bbh-poc Slack channel.

Thanks — Karthik
